I'm focusing on "click-by-click" instructions, with bold text for UI elements, numbering, and avoiding pitfalls.

Here is your precise, click-by-click guide to getting your Google Firebase credentials and enabling the cloud database.

### Phase 1: Create the Project
1.  Open a new tab and go to **[console.firebase.google.com](https://console.firebase.google.com/)**.
2.  Log in with your Google account if asked.
3.  Click the big white card that says **"Create a project"** (or "Add project").
4.  Enter a project name (e.g., **MatchUp Padel**).
5.  Click **Continue**.
6.  Turn **OFF** "Enable Google Analytics for this project" (it simplifies setup).
7.  Click **Create project**.
8.  Wait for the loader to finish, then click **Continue**.

### Phase 2: Create the Database
*This is the step most people miss, causing "Permission Denied" errors.*

1.  In the left sidebar menu, look under **Build** and click **Firestore Database**.
2.  Click the **Create database** button.
3.  **Crucial Step:** A popup will ask about location. Leave it as default or pick a region close to you. Click **Next**.
4.  **Security Rules:** Select **Start in test mode**.
    *   *Note: This allows anyone with your API keys to read/write for 30 days. It is perfect for development/demos.*
5.  Click **Create**.
6.  Wait a moment until you see an empty database panel (it will say "Collection ID").

### Phase 3: Get the Credentials
1.  Click the **Project Overview** (House icon) at the very top left of the sidebar.
2.  In the center of the screen, look for the text "Get started by adding Firebase to your app".
3.  Click the **Web** icon (it looks like `</>`).
4.  App nickname: Enter **MatchUp Web**.
5.  Uncheck "Also set up Firebase Hosting".
6.  Click **Register app**.
7.  You will see a code block containing `const firebaseConfig = { ... };`.
8.  **Keep this tab open.** You need to copy the values inside that object.

PRIVACY POLICY
Effective Date: [Insert Date]
This Privacy Policy describes how our WhatsApp-based AI booking agent (the "Service") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you interact with our automated booking system for sports club hourly slot reservations.
1. Information We Collect
1.1 Information You Provide
When you use our booking service through WhatsApp, we collect:
•	Your WhatsApp phone number
•	Your name (if provided during booking)
•	Booking details (date, time, sport type, number of participants)
•	Payment information (processed through secure third-party payment processors)
•	Messages and communications sent to the AI agent
1.2 Automatically Collected Information
We automatically collect:
•	Message metadata (timestamps, delivery status)
•	Interaction patterns with the AI agent
•	Technical information (WhatsApp webhook data, session information)
2. How We Use Your Information
We use your information to:
•	Process and manage your sports club bookings
•	Send booking confirmations, reminders, and updates
•	Respond to your inquiries and customer service requests
•	Improve our AI agent's performance and accuracy
•	Prevent fraud and ensure security of the booking system
•	Comply with legal obligations and enforce our terms of service
•	Analyze usage patterns to optimize service availability
3. Information Sharing and Disclosure
We may share your information with:

Your booking information is shared with the sports club where you make reservations to facilitate your booking and ensure service delivery.

We work with third-party service providers:
•	Meta Platforms, Inc. (WhatsApp Business API provider)
•	AI and cloud hosting providers for service operation
•	Payment processors for handling transactions
•	Analytics and customer support service providers

Our Service operates on the Meta WhatsApp Business Platform. Your use of WhatsApp is governed by Meta's Privacy Policy and WhatsApp Terms of Service. We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide the Service and fulfill the purposes outlined in this Privacy Policy. Booking records are typically retained for [specify period, e.g., 2 years] for business and legal compliance purposes. You may request deletion of your data subject to legal retention requirements.
6. Data Security
We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your information, including encryption, secure webhook endpoints, access controls, and regular security assessments. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
7. Your Rights
Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:
•	Access: Request access to your personal information
•	Correction: Request correction of inaccurate information
•	Deletion: Request deletion of your personal information
•	Opt-out: Opt-out of marketing communications
•	Data Portability: Request a copy of your data in a portable format

To exercise these rights, please contact us at [insert contact email].

Your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place for international data transfers in compliance with applicable data protection laws.
9. Children's Privacy
Our Service is not intended for individuals under the age of 13 (or the applicable age of digital consent in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we become aware of such collection, we will take steps to delete the information.

Our Service uses artificial intelligence to understand and respond to your messages, process bookings, and provide customer support. Address: [Insert your business address]

### 1. The "AI Match Journalist" (Engagement & Content)
**The Problem:** Raw scores (6-4, 6-2) are boring for people who missed the match. Organizers rarely have time to write write-ups for every game.
**The AI Solution:**
Use the `match.score.history` and `refereeNotes` data to generate a **dramatic match summary** instantly after a game ends.

*   **How it works:** You send the point history and tags (e.g., "Clutch Performance", "Tiebreak") to Gemini.
*   **Usability Benefit:**
    *   **Spectators:** Get a story-like recap of the match instantly.

*   **Example Output:** *"In a thrilling Quarter Final at Center Court, **Team Alpha** edged out **The Smashers** (6-4, 7-6). The match was defined by a tense second-set tiebreak where Player 1 delivered a clutch performance."*

### 2. Smart Schedule Optimizer (Organizer Efficiency)
**The Problem:** Your current auto-schedule is linear. In real life, teams need rest periods, specific courts might be unavailable, or "Star Players" might need to play on "Center Court" for visibility.
**The AI Solution:**

**The Problem:** Referees have to look down at their phone to tap buttons (`Point Team 1`). This takes their eyes off the court and breaks focus.

*   **How it works:** The referee wears an earbud/mic and says *"Point Team 1"* or *"Correction, remove last point."* The AI parses the intent and updates the state.
*   **Usability Benefit:**
    *   **Hands-free:** Referees can focus entirely on the game.
    *   **Speed:** Faster than navigating UI menus for corrections.

### 4. The "Rulebook RAG" (Dispute Resolution)
**The Problem:** Padel rules can be tricky (e.g., touching the net, serves hitting the fence). Disputes slow down tournaments.
**The AI Solution:**
A chatbot embedded in the Referee Interface trained specifically on the **Official FIP Padel Rules**.

*   **How it works:** A referee types/speaks: *"Ball hit the wall then the fence on a serve, is it in?"* The AI answers instantly with the specific rule citation.
*   **Usability Benefit:**
